home.title: WorkoutPilot
home.subtitle: Your launch hub
home.description: Start here and jump into the app's key views. Use quick links to explore and try the pose demo.

language.title: Language
language.description: Follows the system language automatically. Switch to override while the app is open.

explore.title: Explore
explore.description: Review the project guide and how to navigate it.
explore.accessibilityHint: Opens the guide and internal documentation screen

exercises.title: Exercises
exercises.description: Try the pose demo: native on mobile and web in the browser.
exercises.accessibilityHint: Opens the exercises screen with pose detection

devShortcuts.title: Developer shortcuts
devShortcuts.description: Edit routes in app/index.tsx, app/explore/index.tsx and app/exercises/index.tsx. Adjust navigation in app/_layout.tsx.

reset.title: Need a reset?
reset.description: Run npm run reset-project to regenerate the app folder from the base template.

routing.title: File-based routing
paragraphs: The app uses routes in app/: home lives in app/index.tsx, explore in app/explore/index.tsx, and exercises in app/exercises/index.tsx.
Adjust navigation in app/_layout.tsx using a Stack.

platforms.title: Cross-platform support
paragraphs: Open the project on Android, iOS, and web. Press w in the terminal to launch the web build.
Exercises uses a native component and a web component depending on the platform.

images.title: Images
paragraphs: Use @2x and @3x suffixes for static assets to keep sharp resolution.

theming.title: Light/dark theming
paragraphs: Use the useColorScheme() hook to adapt colors. ThemedText and ThemedView already respond to the theme.

animations.title: Animations
paragraphs: HelloWave uses react-native-reanimated for a simple gesture.
ParallaxScrollView applies a parallax effect on iOS.

messages.promptCameraAccess: Allow the camera and press "Start webcam".

switchCamera.label: Switch Camera
switchCamera.accessibilityHint: Switch between front and back camera

web.title: Exercises (Web)
web.subtitle: Quick demo with @mediapipe/tasks-vision (ImageSegmenter).
footer: Model and WASM are served from /public.
Pose uses PoseLandmarker and draws 33 joints on the canvas.
